subject: Request: vulnerability assessment / report access — FinTrust regulatory request

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request for vulnerability assessment / pen test report (time-sensitive)

Hi Vanessa,

We're running a regulator-led review this week and need to collect recent third-party security validation for critical vendors. Given recent suspicious activity reported in our environment, our security and compliance teams have asked for the most recent vulnerability/penetration test report you can provide for Redwood's hosted inference stack.

Specific asks:
- Executive summary or board-level findings (redacted acceptable)
- Remediation matrix showing which issues remain open and timelines
- Confirmation whether any findings indicate customer data exposure or vector from our S3/SSO integration

Can you share what you can by EOD Thursday? If full reports require an NDA or additional steps, please outline the process and ETA. This is high priority for our audit.

Thanks,
Ben Jensen

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:08:42 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for vulnerability assessment / pen test report (FinTrust)

Vanessa / Steph — short summary of what we can provide and constraints.

What we can share now (recommended):
- Redacted Executive Summary (removes PoC detail, IP addresses, and internal node identifiers).
- Remediation Matrix (status, owner, completion ETA).
- Timeline of last external test (Nov 2025) and a high-level summary of critical/medium findings and the fixes applied.

What we will not share without additional controls:
- Full penetration test raw report that includes exploit code, live IPs, and detailed step-by-step proofs — we only release that under a mutual NDA + signed data-handling addendum, or through a controlled in-person review.

Attachments I'm preparing:
- [Attachment: redacted_exec_summary.pdf (PDF, ~92 KB)]
- [Attachment: remediation_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, ~40 KB)]

Suggested redactions:
- Remove any test harness hostnames and internal VM IDs.
- Strip PoC examples and exploit commands.
- Keep vulnerability identifiers (CVE/CWE) and classification (critical/medium/low) intact.

If FinTrust insists on the full report, we escalate to Legal + SOC2 team for NDA. ETA: redacted bundle ready in ~3 business hours.

Marissa Cole
Security Engineering Lead, Red Team
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Ben / Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and request. Attached is a redacted executive summary and a remediation matrix that addresses your specific asks.

What we included:
- Executive summary with findings by severity (redacted to remove PoC details and internal host identifiers).
- Remediation matrix with status, assigned owner, and expected completion dates.
- Confirmation: based on our testing and telemetry, we have no evidence that Redwood's hosted inference service is the source of any data exfiltration in your environment. Our findings relate to standard configuration weaknesses and patching timelines; full details are in the redacted summary.

If you need the unredacted, full penetration test report we will require a signed NDA and our Legal to approve the disclosure flow; I can coordinate that immediately if you want us to proceed. For quicker turnaround, the redacted bundle should satisfy most regulator asks.

Secure download: https://secure-share.redwood.ai/s/fintrust/abc123 (expires in 7 days)

Attachments:
- redacted_exec_summary.pdf
- remediation_matrix.xlsx

Next steps: please confirm receipt and let me know if your audit team needs an attestation statement from our SOC2 owner; we can also schedule a 30-min brief with Marissa to walk through the remediation matrix.

Best,

Vanessa — received, thank you. The redacted summary and matrix look good for our audit intake. We may request the full report under NDA — I will circulate an internal request and circle back with the scanned NDA if needed.

A couple quick clarifications for our security team:
- Can Marissa confirm whether any of the redacted critical findings had residual exposure windows after your remediation (i.e., were there any time periods where data could have been accessed)?
- We would appreciate a short note we can include in our regulator package confirming Redwood performed the test in Nov 2025 and that findings were remediated on the dates listed in the matrix.

If you can provide a 15–20 minute call with Marissa next week for our auditors, that would help.

Thanks again — Ben
